title: Multi-hop Evidence Pursuit Meets the Web: Team Papelo at FEVER 2024

model.params_source: paper Sec. 4 (gpt-4o-2024-05-13, seed 42); temperature and max_tokens assumed

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: first 200 examples of the AVeriTeC dev set
task.approximation: live Google search and trafilatura scraping at run time differ from mid-2024 results; LLM+LLM configuration (all question generation by the LLM, no fine-tuned T5); the official AVeriTeC scorer (lambda = 0.25) is run as released

items.source: chenxwh/AVeriTeC (data/dev.json, official release) or dataset mirror pminervini/averitec (split dev, 500 rows)

fields.label: label (Supported / Refuted / Not Enough Evidence / Conflicting Evidence/Cherrypicking) and questions (gold question-answer evidence for the AVeriTeC score)

prompt.user_template:
### FUNCTION: GetFirstQuestion
We are trying to verify the following claim by {speaker} on {date}. Claim: {claim} We aren't sure whether this claim is true or false. Please write one or more questions that would help us verify this claim, as a JSON list of strings. Keep the list short.

### FUNCTION: GetNextQuestion
We are trying to verify the following claim by {speaker} on {date}. Claim: {claim} So far we have asked the questions: {qa_list} Based on these questions and answers, can you verify whether the claim is true or false? Please answer [[True]] or [[False]], or ask one more question that would help you verify.

### FUNCTION: LLMBestDoc
We searched the web and found the following information. {search_results} Based on the above information, please answer the following question, referring to the one document that best answers the question. {question}

### FUNCTION: LLMAnswer
We searched the web and found the following information. Document ({title}, from {site}, published {date_doc}): {context} Based on the above information, please answer the following question.{question}

### FUNCTION: Paraphrase
Please give four ways to rephrase the following question. Give your answer as a JSON list of strings, each string being one question. Question: {question}

### FUNCTION: LLMVerify
We are trying to verify the following claim: {claim} Based on our web searches, we resolved the following questions. {numbered_qa_list} Is the claim (A) fully supported by the evidence, or (B) contradicted by the evidence? Please respond in the format [[A]] or [[B]].

placeholders.FUNCTION: Algorithm 1 / 2 call each block in turn: GetFirstQuestion -> loop {GetAnswer = WebSearch(claim + question) -> LLMBestDoc -> FullDocument(trafilatura) -> AlignContext(5-sentence window) -> LLMAnswer} -> GetNextQuestion until [[True]]/[[False]] or n questions -> Paraphrase to fill up to n QA pairs -> LLMVerify
placeholders.speaker: items.speaker
placeholders.search_results: 'Document 0 ({title0}, from {site0}, published {date0}): {snippet0} ... Document 9 (...)' from the top-10 web results
placeholders.title|site|date_doc|context: metadata and the aligned five-sentence window of the chosen document

prompt.source_location: Appendix B (prompts for GetFirstQuestion, GetNextQuestion, LLMBestDoc, LLMAnswer, Paraphrase, LLMVerify)
prompt.verbatim: full (italic slot names turned into placeholders; the blocks are concatenated under '### FUNCTION:' headers that are not part of any prompt)

output.parse: GetFirstQuestion/Paraphrase: json list of strings; GetNextQuestion: regex \[\[(True|False)\]\] else first sentence containing '?'; LLMBestDoc: regex Document\s+([0-9]) or Documents[ 0-9,]+and ([0-9]+); LLMVerify: regex \[\[(A|B)\]\] -> Supported / Refuted
output.postprocess: verdict plus the generated question-answer pairs are written in the AVeriTeC submission format and scored with the official evaluate script

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: AVeriTeC score at lambda = 0.25: accuracy of the veracity label counted only for claims whose generated evidence reaches Hungarian-METEOR >= 0.25 against the gold questions/answers (official scorer)
metric.original_location: Table 2, row LLM+LLM, column AVeriTeC 0.25 (first 200 dev examples)

open_points: Agent loop with external services: live Google web search + trafilatura scraping inside a multi-call question/answer/verify loop (about 45 calls per claim) and the official AVeriTeC scorer with its METEOR dependency; beyond one main + one judge stage and outside the hook rules (no network at run time, stdlib/numpy/pandas only).
The maximum number of questions n per claim (Algorithm 1) is not printed.
notes: About 45 short gpt-4o calls per claim (record estimate 9,000 calls at ~$0.005). Verdicts are limited to Supported/Refuted as in the paper's best configuration. || [hooks_2 2026-09-07] reviewed for a per-paper hook: multi-call agent loop + web search; no hook written.
hook: none (needs_human: multi-call agent loop + web search)
